# `combinational-delay`: Combinational logic contains a procedural delay / 组合逻辑中包含过程延时

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

A combinational process uses a delay control even though synthesizable combinational hardware is defined by logic, not simulator time delays.

### Risk

The delay may be ignored or transformed by tools, so simulation timing can diverge from the synthesized circuit.

### Fix

Remove the delay from synthesizable combinational logic and place timing stimulus in a testbench or model intended latency with clocked logic.

## 简体中文

### 原因

组合过程使用了延时控制，但可综合组合硬件由逻辑关系决定，而不是由仿真时间延时决定。

### 风险

工具可能忽略或改写该延时，导致仿真时序与综合后的电路不一致。

### 修复

从可综合组合逻辑中删除延时；测试激励的时间控制放入 testbench，需要真实延迟时使用时钟逻辑建模。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module combinational_delay(input logic a, input logic b, output logic y);
  always_comb begin
    #1 y = a & b;
  end
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module combinational_delay(input logic a, input logic b, output logic y);
  always_comb begin
    y = a & b;
  end
endmodule
```
